rows.en:
YES!

ONE-EIGHT WILL SEARCH! RIDE ON MY SHOULDER!
Forward, One-Eight! Let's find my mom!

So this is One-Seven's little brother robot?

No wonder Chief Kitakura mistook it…

There's a boy on its shoulder…!?

A boy is riding on the robot's shoulder! We can't attack like this!
What…!?
It's Yazaki…

Damn it… Don't touch One-Eight!

Shoot down the Kelbaan first! All units, open fire!

One-Eight! You damn moron!

How long are you going to play with that snot-nosed brat!? Destroy the Project B laboratory! One-Eight, those are Brain's orders! Smash it!

…!?

Chief Kitakura, what are you doing here!?
I've brought Yazaki's mother.
Yazaki's… mother!?

Yazaki's mother was in a traffic accident and lost her memory…

She'd been in the hospital without even knowing who she was.

Just now, she saw Yazaki riding on One-Eight's shoulder on the hospital TV, and remembered everything!

So that's what happened…

Yazaki, look! It's your mom! We found your mom!

…!?

Is that… Mom!?

Wait, One-Eight! It's Mom, my mom is here! Please, let me down!
MOTHER? ONE-EIGHT UNDERSTANDS…
Yazaki, isn't that great!?
Thank you, everyone…
Chief Kitakura, how are your injuries?

I'm fine, as you can see!

It was my fault One-Seven was under suspicion. I couldn't just sit still! I'm sorry, Saburo…
Chief Kitakura…
All right, open fire on One-Eight!
One-Seven!? Are you all right now!? I was worried about you!
THAT IS… ONE-SEVEN'S LITTLE BROTHER, ONE-EIGHT!

…!?

One-Seven… you can talk now?
YES…

I see… You learned to speak while you were with us, didn't you?

This is amazing… I can talk freely with One-Seven!
The letters on its chest say One-Eight…
This is going to be a painful fight for One-Seven, isn't it?
No way… The letters on its chest say One-Eight!

Heh heh heh… So you've shown up, One-Seven! This time I'll settle things with you!

Heeey, One-Eight… Brain's orders! Destroy One-Seven, laboratory and all! Destroy him!
ONE-SEVEN IS THE ENEMY!
IS THAT… YOUR HEART, LITTLE BROTHER?
BROTHER ONE-SEVEN! THIS TIME I WILL NOT FORGIVE YOU!
ONE-EIGHT, LITTLE BROTHER… I WILL NOT ALLOW YOU TO DESTROY THE LABORATORY!
SHUT UP! CAN YOU BEAT ONE-EIGHT, BROTHER?
I WANTED A LITTLE BROTHER… BUT ONE-EIGHT! I DO NOT NEED YOU!
WHAT…!? I AM THE ONE WHO DOES NOT NEED A TRAITOR!
AAAH… BROTHEEER!

YOU DO NOT UNDERSTAND YOUR BROTHER'S HEART! FORGIVE ME, LITTLE BROTHER!

ONE-SEVEN IS SAD…
One-Seven didn't use Graviton…
I'm sorry for all the trouble I caused.
But… are you really all right now?

Yes…

By the way… what happened to the liaison officer from the Caribbean Branch?

Mm… He was a Brain spy. I handed over the Project B documents without knowing it!

By now, Brain must know everything about Project B…
It's such a shame, isn't it? All our work on Project B…

No, machines can be built again as many times as you like…

But human lives cannot be built… The most important thing is that everyone is safe. We can start Project B over again any time.
One-Seven has laid his little brother robot, One-Eight, to rest. With sorrow in his heart… and a new fighting spirit ablaze, he takes on Brain! Don't lose, One-Seven!
One-Seven defeated his little brother robot, One-Eight. But the heart of the older brother, who chose to hold back his Graviton, miraculously kept his little brother alive!
With Dr. Sahara's help, One-Eight has the "Saturn Circuit" removed, the devilish device that made him obey only Brain's orders, and is reborn as a robot of justice…
One-Seven and One-Eight… With these two together, no enemy stands a chance! Before the decisive battle with the Brain Party, burn with new fighting spirit, One-Seven!
Whoaaa…!
Ngh… I've still got a long way to go… Uuugh…
One-Seveeen…!
Defeat all the Kelbaan and rescue young Yazaki!
Defeat One-Eight, the Gigants and all the Kelbaan!
Saburo Minami is defeated
Saburo Minami or Captain Sawa is defeated, or One-Eight is destroyed
The laboratory or One-Seven is destroyed
Space Sheriff Gavan, locked in fierce battles with the enemy…
Even so, between battles he was searching for his father, Voicer, believed to be held captive by Makuu.
Are you Hunter Killer?
Who's there!? Come out!
The son of Don Horror, the Demon King of the Universe…
Don Horror's son?
Heh heh heh… I hear the Space Sheriffs have been making quite a fool of you.

How rude!

Underestimate Gavan, and you'll get burned too!

Hmph… You loathsome spy!

Your role is over… Now learn your lesson! Hahaha…
Gavan… I have good news!

Good news!?

Did you get engaged or something?
I'm going to get mad!

Ah, sorry, sorry…

So? What's the good news?

They say Hunter Killer's been arrested!

Space Sheriff Alan found him on patrol, drifting around the Dark Galaxy, and took him into custody…

Hunter Killer!?

I see… So he finally fell from power and was banished?
They say we might be able to find out where your father is!
My father!?

Apparently Hunter Killer knows!

My father is questioning him at the Galactic Police Hospital on Planet Bird! If they learn anything, they'll contact…
I see… Hunter Killer…

The Hoshino Space Cannon is a laser cannon with terrifying power, able to destroy other planets while sitting right here on Earth!

Once this Space Cannon is complete, you can become ruler of the universe, Father…

Planet Bird, Andromeda's third planet… There are still so many planets in my way that I want to destroy!

Hurry and complete the Hoshino Space Cannon!

However, that Voicer…

will not confess anything about the blueprints of the crucial laser amplification system, no matter what we do.

uncertain: U10265/U10312/U10313: ケルバーン taken as several units ("the Kelbaan"); 撃筺 read as 撃墜 "shoot down".
U10285/U10287: 膤の文字 read as 胸の文字, the letters on the robot's chest.
U10288: "Destroy him" - Hustler's target is One-Seven.
U10297: "Forgive me" - One-Seven apologizes as he defeats One-Eight.
U10306: 蚶印 read as 封印 (he sealed away his own Graviton); rendered "chose to hold back his Graviton".
U10316: 怯霍身 unreadable; guessed 研究所 (laboratory) from the scene (Hustler targets the lab). Please verify.
U10319-U10325: Mysterious Voice is Sandoruba (he speaks U10325 under his name).
U10334: bare お父様 read as Mimi's own father (Commander Kom), since U10332 says ギャバンのお父様 explicitly for Voicer; Kom reports the result in B0130.

new_names.why: Gavan's enemy organization; glossary has Makuu Space only
